text:
sara: 15m till all-hands. tiny change: pushing the org updates to the end and pulling the OKR Q&A forward. saves folks who need to drop after product demo.

nora: noted. can product folks confirm their demo feeds are ready? jamie, you good for the latency demo?

jamie: yes demo VM is up. quick heads-up: Ill screen-share a terminal and a local model container, so we might need to toggle 'optimize for full-screen' in Zoom.

michael-ops: AV/stream checklist: captions will be enabled via Zoom CC, but the live auto-caption sometimes lags. We're testing a secondary stream to YouTube with manual captions.

lina: interpreter request came in last minute for ASL. can we set up a stage cam pointing at the interpreter box? we have one volunteer.

stream-bot: scheduled action: enable_live_captioning -> true at 1770024700. fallback_stream -> youtube_live at 1770024715.

sara: love that. lina please coordinate with the interpreter for where to stand. we'll put the interpreter box in the lower-right of the slides.

nora: small security note: there's one slide with customer PII in the demo deck. jamie pls mark it as 'do not stream' and we'll do an in-room demo for that section only.

jamie: marked in the deck and replaced with a placeholder for the stream. in-room only clip will be cued for ~2 minutes.

michael-ops: ops reminder: if the Zoom captions fail, we will pause the livestream and switch audio to the local OBS feed. Everyone on stage, pls keep a backup mic near you.

lina: comms ask: can we pin a single post in #all-hands with the recording retention policy and the post-meeting survey link? i'll draft a blurb now.

sara: yes pin it. retention = 6 months by default; if leadership approves we'll extend. include an opt-in for extended archive requests.

jamie: for the OKR Q&A, I'll paste 3 prepared notes into this thread for the live moderator to read if the chat is quiet.

stream-bot: reminder: 2 minutes until start. Zoom participant limit checked. captions service latency = 1.2s (estimated).

nora: moderation flow: we'll rotate questions to keep time. :hourglass_flowing_sand: Alex is on deck for the first two product questions, sara will take leadership strategy, nora will handle product/OKR clarifications. Use :hand: reaction to request to speak.

lina: uploaded final deck link: https://drive.google.com/rd/allhands-apr2026-final-deck. please do not edit after 5 minutes before start.

sara: last ask: if you have sensitive slides, flag them now or they'll be included in the public recording. any last volunteers for raw audio tracks?

jamie: i'll capture raw track for the demo. michael-ops will capture system audio too.

michael-ops: confirmed. OBS multitrack will be started at cue. i'll upload to Drive after we've checked permissions.

stream-bot: action log: captions_enabled, youtube_fallback_ready, obs_multitrack_queue_set.

sara: thanks team. see you on stage. We'll call for a 10s countdown if we need to swap to the fallback stream. :thumbsup:
